annotations.label: T cells (naive-like, CCR7+ LDHB+; CD4/CD8 split unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: LDHB (90% vs 61%) and CCR7 (46% vs 11%) are enriched. CD3D is detected in 85%, CD3E in 72%, SELL in 60%. CD4 is detected in 7% and CD8A in 16%. Versus cluster 1, CD3D/CD3E do not differ. Abstracts support CD3D/CD3E as T-cell genes only. Naive-like is an inference.

annotations.label: T cells (CD4-like memory/activated; IL7R+ AQP3+)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD3D (91%), CD3E, IL7R (76% vs 31%), CD2, LTB and IL32 are enriched. AQP3, TNFRSF4 and CD40LG are also enriched, with S100A4 in 94%. This suggests CD4-like memory T cells (inference). CD4 transcript is detected in only 15%. Abstracts support CD3D/CD3E/CD2 as T-cell genes, not IL7R, AQP3 or CD40LG.

annotations.label: CD14+ classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: LGALS2, S100A8, S100A9, FCN1, CD14 (66% vs 3%) and LYZ are strongly enriched. Abstracts support CD14+ monocytes and S100A8/S100A9 in classical monocytes. They do not support LGALS2, FCN1 or LYZ. FCGR3A is detected in 14%. The cluster is adjacent to the small cluster 7 on the UMAP.

annotations.label: B cells (naive-like features)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD79A (94% vs 4%), MS4A1, CD79B, TCL1A, BANK1 and VPREB3 are strongly enriched, with MHC class II genes. FCER2 and TCL1A suggest a naive-like subset (inference, not tested). PMID 38770541 names CD79A and MS4A1 as B-cell markers, but in a CLL case, so scope is limited. Distinct UMAP island.

annotations.label: CD8+ effector/memory-like cytotoxic T cells (GZMK+)
annotations.notes: Computed: NKG7, CCL5, GZMA, CST7 and GZMK are enriched. CD8A (46% vs 7%), CD8B, GZMH and KLRG1 are also enriched, and CD3D is detected in 84%. KLRF1 is detected in 5% and NCAM1 in 0.3%, so NK cells are unlikely to dominate. Abstracts support NKG7/GNLY/granzymes as cytotoxic genes, not GZMK or CCL5.

annotations.label: FCGR3A+ (CD16+) non-classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: FCGR3A (91% vs 14%), MS4A7, CDKN1C, LILRA3, CSF1R and LST1 are enriched. CD14 is detected in 16% versus 66% in cluster 2. Cytotoxic genes are absent from the top markers, which argues against NK cells. Abstracts support FCGR3A+ and CD16-high monocyte subsets, not MS4A7, CDKN1C or LILRA3.

annotations.label: NK cells (CD16+ cytotoxic)
annotations.notes: Computed: GZMB, SPON2, FGFBP2, PRF1, GNLY, KLRD1 and NKG7 (100% of cells) are strongly enriched. FCGR3A is detected in 89% and KLRF1 in 27%. CD3D is detected in 7%, CD8A in 8% and CD4 in 0%, which favors NK over T cells. NCAM1 is low (7%). Abstracts support GNLY/NKG7/GZMB/PRF as cytotoxic genes in NK cells.

annotations.label: Dendritic cells (CD1C+ cDC-like; pDC admixture possible)
annotations.notes: Computed: FCER1A (83% vs 1%), CLEC10A, CD1C and SERPINF1 are enriched in only 36 cells. CLEC4C, LILRA4 and IL3RA appear in 11–17%, so pDCs may be mixed in. Abstract support is limited: tumor scRNA FCER1A+CD1C+ DCs (38582791) and iPSC-derived CD1c+ cDC2 (35101945). Partial overlap, so tentative. Forms a UMAP tail near monocytes.
